response.overview: In a remote Iraqi village around 1940, a prolonged drought destroys the crops and kills the livestock. While some villagers resign themselves to their fate or dream of moving to Baghdad, Zayer Radi and his son Hashim decide to dig a well in search of water. Their perseverance tests the community’s solidarity and brings rivalries, unfulfilled love, and secrets to the surface, threatening to tear the village apart.
response.title: The Thirsties
